about:
National Food Equipment & Supplies (NFE) operates from Commerce Township, Michigan. The company traces its roots to 1963 when it began as a single-line equipment distributor. Now in its second generation of family ownership, NFE has expanded into a full-service commercial food equipment supplier and consultant serving Southeastern Michigan.

NFE provides kitchen layout and design services, producing CAD drawings that include equipment schedules, electrical and plumbing specifications. The firm also assists with Department of Health or Agriculture applications and manages equipment receiving, staging, delivery, and set-in-place installation. As an authorized distributor for brands such as Mettler-Toledo — offering weighing scales, labeling systems, and price-computing scales — NFE represents both major and niche equipment lines to match customer budgets and requirements.

The company serves restaurants, bars, specialty gourmet food markets, supermarkets, bakeries, delicatessens, institutions, and catering facilities. Its project experience spans new builds and remodels for independent operators and multi-unit chains alike.

NFE emphasizes customer service, integrity, and timely, cost-effective project completion. The firm’s differentiator lies in combining design expertise with a broad product portfolio, allowing it to act as a single point of contact from concept through installation.
